context: Generative art / tech demo — a phyllotaxis golden-angle spiral with animated oscillation, palette switching, and pointer interaction
first_impression: A dark circular mass that hints at spiral structure but fails to deliver the glowing phyllotaxis effect its palette system promises
what_works: Control panel chrome is genuinely polished — uppercase monospace value readouts, accent-color sliders, and the title/subtitle typographic hierarchy (light weight, muted color, letter-spacing) show real design intent. Palette swatch picker is clean.
what_doesnt: The core visual is broken at this render state: with 2000 dots the per-dot alpha bottoms out at ~0.08, and additive blending on a #111 background produces a near-invisible dark gray blob rather than the intended colored glow — the ocean-blue palette is essentially undetectable. The phyllotaxis spiral structure, the main thing the demo exists to show, cannot be distinguished by a viewer looking at the screenshot.
